title: Deep learning model to diagnose cardiac amyloidosis from haematoxylin/eosin-stained myocardial tissue.
summary: Deep learning localized and classified amyloid in HE-stained myocardial biopsy patches against pathologist/stain reference labels, a specific diagnostic validation result with single-centre limits.
ai_technology: deep learning scored 224×224 HE biopsy patches from 166 patients; pathological labels were established by pathologists and amyloid staining.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: patch AUC 0.965 and specimen-level AUC 1.0 in the evaluation set.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective single-centre 2:1 development/evaluation; no external validation, so perfect specimen AUC is limited to this small cohort.
evidence.ai_role: deep learning scored 224×224 HE biopsy patches from 166 patients; pathological labels were established by pathologists and amyloid staining.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
